comments.author: redtigerpro
comments.body:
Hello!  I am the developer of Death & Taxes MRPG.  I've been working on this game for a long time now in many different forms.  I use Meshy for Models and Animation and Cursor for coding.  This current iteration (Early Access multiplayer) has been in development for about 1 year.  

Please join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/dRjZP65) to follow the game and wishlist on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3960500/Death__Taxes_Multiplayer_RPG/).
